subject: FlowWorks Modern pipe system redo: UniversalPipe Modern atlas B_field_worn, RM_SprinklerHead Modern B_field_worn
looked_at: pipe atlas B at full 704 px, composited on a dirt-tone ground
laid run B at true scale (64 px/cell, vanilla human) and the same run as shipped; 3x nearest-neighbour crops of the long horizontal run of both and of the tee/sprinkler/elbow leg of B
laid run B at 32 px/cell (half-size copy)
sprinkler B at full 256 px beside the shipped RM_SprinklerHead.png on a dirt-tone ground, and a 4x crop of B
alpha of sprinkler B checked identical to shipped (numpy, True)

verdicts.improves_why: Shipped is saturated sky-blue with a glossy stripe (plastic); B is faded grey-blue steel with rust weeps.
verdicts.notes: Owner 2026-11-22 'They look plastic' and looks.md Modern 'Must NOT look like ... a flat clean colour with a glossy highlight': answered; the body is a desaturated, mottled waterworks blue that reads as painted/galvanised steel, not plastic. 'patches of differently colored paint or other non-cartoonishness': small red-oxide/rust smudges sit on the underside of horizontal runs and on elbows. Repeat question: the straight horizontal cell carries one patch, so a long horizontal run shows one smudge per cell at a regular cadence; at true scale (64 px/cell) and at 32 px/cell the smudges are small, low-contrast and hug the lower edge, so the run reads as a weathered pipe, not a stripe pattern; no full-circumference band, unlike the refused candy stripe. B6 (no bright red tier marker): the oxide patches are dull and small, not a tier colour. C6: no bore shown on lying runs; caps and the valve disc are unchanged shapes. D4: alpha unchanged, no halo.

verdicts.improves_why: Shipped is bright glossy toy-blue; B is faded, scuffed, rust-flecked painted metal.
verdicts.notes: Owner 2026-11-22 'Same for the Sprinkler': answered; the rim is sun-faded grey-blue with edge wear, rust flecks near the bolts and across the face, and the bolts and centre cap read as bare steel. It matches pipe B's paint so the head seats on the run as one system (seen on the run panel). Not cartoonish, no glossy highlight, no primary tier colour (B6). Alpha identical to shipped (D4, D3 unchanged).

polish: pipe B: vertical straight cells carry no patches, so N-S runs read cleaner than E-W runs; a faint patch on the vertical cell would even them out (polish).

pipe B: on a long E-W run the one-patch-per-cell cadence is visible when you look for it at 3x; offsetting patch position between the straight cell and the end-cap cells already helps, nothing more owed (polish).
pipe B: at 32 px/cell the wear nearly vanishes and the pipe reads as plain faded grey-blue; acceptable, since the plastic look is gone too (polish).
sprinkler B: the wear is rust flecks rather than a distinct patch of older/touch-up paint; the owner's 'or other non-cartoonishness' covers it (polish).

passed.clause: looks.md Modern: Must NOT look like cartoonish, plastic or toy-like; a flat clean colour with a glossy highlight
